scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix apps/registry-ui && npm ci --prefix apps/registry-ui/auth && npm ci --prefix apps/website
scripts.check: npm run check:registry-ui && npm run check:website
scripts.check:registry-ui: npm --prefix apps/registry-ui run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/registry-ui run lint && npm --prefix apps/registry-ui run format:check
scripts.check:website: npm --prefix apps/website run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/website run lint && npm --prefix apps/website run format:check
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm --prefix apps/registry-ui test && npm --prefix apps/registry-ui run test:auth && npm --prefix apps/website test
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/registry-ui run build && npm --prefix apps/website run build
